indicators.label: Population growth
indicators.desc: Population change over 12 months, same quarter previous year.

indicators.label: Single-person households
indicators.desc: One-person households as % of all households (household size = 1).

indicators.label: Median disposable income
indicators.desc: Median (5th decile boundary) disposable income of persons over 14, DKK/yr.

indicators.label: Higher education
indicators.desc: Residents 15–69 with short-, medium- or long-cycle higher education, %.

indicators.label: Rented dwellings
indicators.desc: Private rental + andel + almene + public dwellings as % of dwellings with known tenure (andel counted as rented, as DST does).

indicators.label: Private rental share
indicators.desc: Privately rented dwellings as % of dwellings with known tenure.

indicators.label: Cooperative (andel) share
indicators.desc: Andelsboliger as % of dwellings with known tenure.

indicators.label: Social housing share
indicators.desc: Almene boliger as % of dwellings with known tenure.

indicators.label: Dwellings built 2010+
indicators.desc: Dwellings taken into use 2010 or later as % of all dwellings.

indicators.label: Unemployed (Nov.)
indicators.desc: Registered unemployed at end of November as % of residents. Published for the 10 districts (bydele) only — every quarter shows its district's value.
indicators.warn: District-level (bydel) figure repeated on each quarter. Denominator is total population, not labour force; comparable between districts, not with the national AUP01 rate.

indicators.label: Rented dwellings (BBR)
indicators.desc: Dwellings registered as rented (enh045 = 1, includes andel) as % of dwellings with a known tenure — BBR unit register, postal-code level.
indicators.warn: BBR snapshot (no history). Owner-reported register data; tenure 'rented' includes cooperative (andel) dwellings.

indicators.label: Unoccupied dwellings (BBR)
indicators.desc: Dwellings registered as 'not in use' (enh045 = 3) as % of dwellings with a known tenure. Owner-reported and slow to update — use as a relative signal between areas, not as a vacancy rate.
indicators.warn: BBR snapshot (no history). Owner-reported register data; tenure 'rented' includes cooperative (andel) dwellings.

indicators.label: Average dwelling size (BBR)
indicators.desc: Mean registered dwelling area (enh026), all dwellings.
indicators.warn: BBR snapshot (no history). Owner-reported register data; tenure 'rented' includes cooperative (andel) dwellings.

indicators.label: Small dwellings < 50 m² (BBR)
indicators.desc: Dwellings under 50 m² as % of dwellings with a registered area — the studio / one-room segment.
indicators.warn: BBR snapshot (no history). Owner-reported register data; tenure 'rented' includes cooperative (andel) dwellings.

indicators.label: Dwellings built 2010+ (BBR)
indicators.desc: Dwellings in buildings commissioned 2010 or later (byg026) as % of dwellings with a known year.
indicators.warn: BBR snapshot (no history). Owner-reported register data; tenure 'rented' includes cooperative (andel) dwellings.

indicators.label: Multi-dwelling buildings (BBR)
indicators.desc: Dwellings in multi-dwelling buildings (byg021 = 140) as % of dwellings.
indicators.warn: BBR snapshot (no history). Owner-reported register data; tenure 'rented' includes cooperative (andel) dwellings.

indicators.label: Dwellings per building (BBR)
indicators.desc: Dwellings divided by residential buildings — building scale: 1–2 = houses, 10+ = blocks.
indicators.warn: BBR snapshot (no history). Owner-reported register data; tenure 'rented' includes cooperative (andel) dwellings.
